tools.name: plan_steps
tools.description: Lays out every step of the job up front for the checklist the person watches: 2 to 8 short names in order, plain words starting with a verb, under 40 characters, no paths, files, commands, code or tool names. The first step starts right away.

tools.name: report_progress
tools.description: Reports progress on a step of the checklist. Every step before it is checked off; at 100 it is checked off and the next one starts. A name not in the plan becomes a new step.
